implemented: Shared phone styles across all 25 pages: overlay hamburger drawer, keyboard focus/dismissal, stacked fields/cards, wrapped filters/actions and bounded dialogs/dropdowns; desktop staff header remains 100px.
Specialty chips have no delete cross. Clicking names the specialty in a themed confirmation; cancellation or failed saves retain the profile and input.
Settings profile opens an anchored menu with Security notifications and Logout. Light switch colors and dark dialog close-icon contrast are readable.

Map search, filters and layers are mutually exclusive; active/ARIA states and focus follow visibility. Query survives switching until explicit reset. Attribution no longer prints escaped translation markup.
Enhanced native selects stay invisible even when disabled; route sorting adopts its existing wrapper. Patient sex and route sort each show one control and one chevron.
Survey directory removes Close survey while the full detail/results page retains it. Public participant language selection remains accessible on phones.

responsive_review.navigation: Overlay does not squeeze page content; scrollable links, outside/Escape dismissal, inert background, focus trap and return focus verified.
responsive_review.unintended_horizontal_overflow: None in accepted page/form/list states; document and map internal scrolling retained.
responsive_review.screenshots: Private under tests/.runtime/ui/; reviewed page contact sheets and refreshed headings, drawers, Settings menus/dialogs/switches and document QR captures.

desktop_comparison.other_differences: Requested dropdown/survey-action repairs, asynchronous form hydration and live map tiles/panning/attribution. Header and page geometry checked separately.

responsive_review.scope: Initial checkpoint evidence. The follow-up below supersedes management states at matching widths.

journeys: Specialty add/cancel/confirm and failed-save retention; profile keyboard/menu/notifications/logout.
Repeated map search/filter/layer switching, query persistence/reset, keyboard shortcuts and enhanced field values/disabled states.
Management editors and reachable save actions, equal-width doctor fields, document staff share and patient QR, full transfer-list filters.

Survey closing only in full details; existing real transfer/survey workflow suite covers drafts, failure/retry, shared worker progress, publication, invitations, anonymous answers and results at root/mounted URLs.

metrics.interpretation: The full UI checkpoint adds one shared responsive stylesheet and 38,847 first-party bytes versus Stage 5. The follow-up adds 6,098 bytes and no files. Menu logic and container rules remain shared; the overlapping duplication indicator is unchanged. Cumulatively 91 fewer files and 62,249 fewer bytes than the original, excluding vendor/generated artifacts.

limitations: External email delivery remains unverified without provider configuration.
External map tile availability varies; existing fallback behavior remains.
Automated phone checks use Chromium touch emulation, rather than physical-device browser testing.

evidence.targeted_pages: tests/.runtime/ui/final (five complete page sets before a fractional-pixel assertion); completed (final Transfer set and full journeys)

next: Wait for user review. Stage 6 consolidation, integrated demonstration, fresh-install verification and clean submission packaging remain separate.

initial_checkpoint_metrics.interpretation: The UI checkpoint adds one shared responsive stylesheet and 32,749 first-party bytes. Drawer/profile logic and phone rules are shared rather than copied per page. The overlapping duplication indicator is unchanged; no reduction is claimed for this checkpoint. Cumulatively 91 fewer files and 68,347 fewer bytes than the original, excluding vendor/generated artifacts.

repairs: Specialty and Security notifications dialogs: themed field hover/focus, animated button hover/focus/press, dialog/backdrop opening and reduced-motion support. Profile menu items also provide hover/focus/press feedback.
Route sort wrapper stays transparent in idle/hover/focus, including light-theme rules; its shared trigger owns the border.

Available-width management reflow covers summaries, compact header/search spacing, filters, panels and populated list rows. Natural row height and contained list scrolling avoid compression. Phone filters retain 44px targets; desktop staff headers remain 100px.
review_followup.regression_method: Check text rectangles inside cards/buttons/rows, neighboring row/control intersections, viewport overflow, header branding/search separation and both navigation states. Intentionally clipped ellipsis labels retain existing behavior.
review_followup.settings_journeys: Hover/focus/opening feedback, suggestion placement and keyboard selection, profile/notifications/logout, specialty addition/cancellation/confirmed removal and retained input after real API failures.
manual_inspection: Compact populated Ambulances/Doctors with navigation open, summaries, filters and contained rows.
Compact Routes with navigation open/closed and its single border.
Dark phone specialty dialog and light desktop Security notifications dialog.
review_followup.evidence_notes: Accepted case index combines complete management page sets from completed/, remaining/ and routes-final/, refreshed by touch-final/. Earlier incomplete/failing runs are diagnostic evidence only. Final Settings results are in settings-final/.
